data.title: English and Russian, the bill currency and SEO

events.goal: Take task #10 through the process completely on your own
requirements: Read the task from the issue in full: the description and the comments
I approve the statement in advance: do not wait for me
If the analyst has questions, choose the simpler and cleaner option, write the decision into the statement and continue
On the third return do not stop: decide on your own, simplify what does not work, without bypassing the checks, and note it in the final report
Do not bypass or disable the checks
Commit in small commits and push
In the body of the commit that closes the task write Closes #10
When the task is ready, run /publish-recording: I approve the draft and the tables in advance, check them yourself by the rules of the skill and publish
Commit the recording, push, open a PR into main and merge it when CI turns green
In the final report describe what changed, with links to the screenshots, which decisions you made without me and what I need to do by hand

events.line: Stopped: task #10 depends on the unresolved #9
events.text:
As you chose, I stopped and did nothing on task #10: there are no new changes, commits or pull requests in the repository.

Why I stopped. #10 says "Start after #9 (Astro + Solid)", and #9 is not done yet: the main branch has neither Astro nor Solid, and there is no pull request or branch for #9; the project is still on Vite and plain TypeScript, all its text is in Russian; #10 relies on the result of #9: two static pages, a sitemap plugin, English as the language of the project.

What to do on your side: first close #9, you can start the process for #9 in a new session. When #9 is in the main branch, start the process for #10 in a fresh session. Then the languages, the currency and SEO can be done right on Astro, and nothing will have to be redone.

If you want, I can do both tasks in one session in a row (#9, then #10) as separate pull requests.

events.line: Accepted, I will write the statement for task #10
events.text:
Write a statement (a plan with acceptance criteria) for task #10. Task #9 (the move to Astro + Solid, the language of the project is English) is already merged. First read the project rules; the plan, the comments in the code, the commits and the documentation are in English, the interface texts are now English and Russian. The checks at the start are green.

The human approved the statement in advance and is absent. Leave no open questions: choose the simpler and cleaner option, write the decision into the plan in the section "Decisions without the human" and continue.

Task #10 is "English and Russian languages and excellent SEO", the second of three, it starts after #9. Languages: English by default at the root, Russian on a separate page, both static; the texts in dictionaries with the same keys, a missing one is caught by types or a test; plurals through Intl.PluralRules, numbers through Intl.NumberFormat; the language switch in the header is a link to the same page in the other language, keeping the bill after #; no auto-redirect by the browser language.

The currency: a switch in the header next to the language, for now US dollars and rubles, the list is extensible, the branching by currency is exhaustive. By default the currency is taken from the language. The currency is a property of the bill: it is written into the "Share" link and kept on a language switch. The amount format follows the language of the page and the currency of the bill through Intl.NumberFormat. Amounts are still stored as integers in minimal units, there is no conversion by rate. Extend the link format compatibly: old links without a currency open, fix old and new ones with tests; do not change the calculation logic.

SEO: on each page title, description, lang, canonical, hreflang (en, ru, x-default), Open Graph and a Twitter card with a 1200×630 image, JSON-LD WebApplication, theme-color; a sitemap for both languages and robots.txt; text visible to a search engine without JavaScript; Lighthouse (mobile) on both pages: SEO 100, accessibility 100, best practices not lower than 95, performance not lower than 95.

The visual check by Playwright screenshots at 360×800, 768×1024 and 1280×800, light and dark theme, empty and filled state, both languages and both currencies; special attention to long captions and the header with two switches at 360 px. The screenshots in the documentation are English, the Russian ones next to them, in the README both sets.

It is done when the checks and CI are green, both pages work, the language switch keeps the bill and the currency, the currency is switched in the header and comes through the link, old links open, the Lighthouse reports meet the thresholds, and the project rules describe how to add texts, languages and currencies.

Derive the site address for canonical and the sitemap from the existing GitHub Pages setting. Check that Lighthouse can be run in the sandbox without adding it to the project dependencies, and decide where the reports lie. The work is big: split it into ordered phases, each a small coherent commit with green checks, each with its own acceptance criteria, at the end a common list of criteria with the way to check. Do not go beyond the task, name what is noticed outside it separately. Return the whole statement.

events.line: Here is the statement: six phases, each with its own criteria
events.text:
The statement for task #10: English and Russian languages, the currency, SEO.

Goal. Visitors get the app in English at the root and in Russian on a separate page. Each bill has its own currency (dollars or rubles), it travels in the "Share" link and survives a language switch. Both pages are fully indexable: complete metadata, a sitemap, robots, a preview image and text visible without JavaScript.

What was checked in the sandbox. The npm registry is available, Lighthouse 13 runs with the preinstalled Chromium. Now on the main page performance, accessibility and best practices give 1.0, SEO 0.9 — the points are lost only because of the missing description. The Astro container can render components inside Vitest together with the Solid island. The sitemap plugin writes an index and one sitemap file, with one sitemap.xml file it will not do. The Intl format for 1250.50: $1,250.50 and ₽1,250.50 on the English page, 1 250,50 $ and 1 250,50 ₽ on the Russian one.

Phase 1, the link with a currency. A new file with the list of currencies and the code check. The link format of version 2 is the names, the expenses and the currency code; version 1 is still read, the currency is then the default for the page. An unknown currency, a missing currency or an extra element is an invalid bill. Criteria: old links open as before, the encoding round trip keeps the bill and the currency.

Phase 2, dictionaries and formatting. All interface texts move to dictionaries in English and Russian with one type, a missing key is a type error. Plurals through Intl.PluralRules, amounts through Intl.NumberFormat, the language is available inside the island through a context. The Russian texts stay verbatim, the English ones are new. The currency becomes the state of the app. Criteria: there are no interface strings in components outside the dictionaries, the Russian page looks as before, the app renders in English.

Phase 3, two static pages and a language switch. One template page builds both languages. The link to the other language carries the bill and the currency in the address; without a fragment only when the bill is empty and the currency is the default. Criteria: the pages have the right lang, the link keeps the bill, there are no redirects and no reading of the browser language.

Phase 4, the currency switch. An ordinary select with a hidden label in the header next to the language link. A change of the currency changes all amounts and the address, and the "link copied" state is reset. In the header at 360 px everything fits without horizontal scroll.

Phase 5, SEO. The site address in the build settings, the sitemap plugin, robots.txt from the same settings, the page head with title, description, canonical, three hreflang, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD WebApplication, a static block "How it works", two preview images of 1200×630.

Phase 6, documentation, screenshots, Lighthouse. The project rules and the README describe the languages and currencies and how to add them; screenshots in both languages, the Lighthouse reports in the documentation; the last commit closes the task.

Tests: currencies, the link format (including fixed strings of the old and new versions), formatting and plurals, dictionaries, the explanation of the calculation in both languages, the app on both pages, metadata and robots, the page render through the container.

Out of scope, noticed: robots.txt on a GitHub project page does not lie at the host root, so the sitemap is useful only if it is submitted to the search console; the type "kopecks" cannot be renamed without touching the calculation; the amount input does not take the language into account; the avatar uses the Russian locale; there is no separate theme-color for the dark theme.

Decisions without the human: the format version 2 with the currency as the third element; the currency is not a field of the bill but lives next to it, so the calculation and its tests do not change; abbreviated currency signs (narrowSymbol); the currency is chosen by an ordinary select, the language by a link with the name in its own language; the language link encodes the current bill anew; one page file instead of two; the site address is taken from the GitHub Pages setting; the sitemap index plus a sitemap file, robots.txt is built from the same setting; one preview image per language; Lighthouse through npx with the preinstalled Chromium, three runs and the median, the reports in the documentation; the amount input does not change; the Russian texts verbatim; the block "How it works" is static markup outside the island.

events.line: Accepted, I do only the first phase: the link with a currency
events.text:
Implement only phase 1 of the approved statement for task #10 — writing the bill currency into the "Share" link, together with the tests of this phase for the currency and the bill code. Do not start the following phases.

Do not commit: the lead commits. Keep the checks green and run them. Write the comments and messages in English. Do not change the calculation and the computation code, add only the currency file and its test. Before finishing run the formatting.

events.line: Here you are. Phase 1 is ready, the checks are green
events.text:
Phase 1 is ready, the checks are green (formatting, types, linter, tests, build). I ran the formatting, did not commit.

A new currency file: the list USD and RUB, the type and the code check, a comment about two digits in the minimal unit. Next to it a test: the check accepts both currencies, rejects foreign values, and each currency has two digits in Intl.NumberFormat.

In the link code the format version is 2, the content is the names, the expenses and the currency code. Version 1 is still read, the currency is then not set; any other version is unsupported. In version 2 a missing currency, an unknown or lowercase code, a non-string or four elements is an invalid bill; in version 1 three elements too. The encoding takes a currency, the parsing result carries it. The module comment describes both versions. I replaced the word "kopecks" with "minimal units" in a comment and one error message — this was not in the plan. The calculation is not touched.

The link tests: the encoding round trip checks the currency for each one, version 2 codes start with "2."; fixed strings for version 1 and version 2 in both currencies; unsupported versions 0, 3 and 99; tables of invalid bills for both versions; random checks with a random currency.

In the app the currency is for now a constant "rubles", it is passed to the "Share" section as a property. In the app tests only mechanical fixes for the new signature, the case "another version" now uses the version 3 code.

Deviations: the "Share" section also encodes the bill, so I passed the constant as a property and did not duplicate it; I made version 1 exportable for the tests; the app tests had to be fixed, otherwise they do not compile.

events.line: Accepted, I will check the first phase against the criteria
events.text:
Review the uncommitted changes by the project rules and the task: phase 1 of task #10 (do not demand the other phases). Criteria: old version 1 links open as before, the currency is not set; new codes start with "2."; the encoding round trip keeps the bill and the currency; version 2 without a currency, with an unknown, lowercase or non-string currency or with four elements is an invalid bill; version 1 with three elements too; other versions are unsupported; the calculation is not touched, in the bill folder there is only the new currency file and the test.

The executor reported four deviations: the currency is passed from the app to the "Share" section through the constant "rubles"; version 1 is exported for the tests; the app tests were fixed mechanically, the case "another version" now uses version 3; the word "kopecks" is replaced with "minimal units" in a comment and one message.

Run the checks. Give the verdict "ACCEPTED" or "SENT BACK FOR REWORK" with concrete remarks (file and line, what and why).

events.line: Returning it: the isLegacy flag switches the behavior of a function
events.text:
SENT BACK FOR REWORK

The checks pass: 342 tests, the linter and the build are clean. All criteria of phase 1 are met: an old link opens without a currency, new codes start with "2.", the encoding round trip keeps the bill and the currency, the literal codes are right, the tables of invalid bills are covered, versions 0, 3 and 99 are unsupported, the calculation is not touched. All four deviations are justified.

Remarks. First: the function that reads a bill by version uses a derived flag that changes its behavior in three places — the tuple length, the error text, whether the currency is read. This breaks the rule "a flag does not switch behavior" and the exhaustive branching. Any version other than the first silently goes the way of the second, and the list of supported versions is duplicated in another function, so neither the compiler nor a test will catch an omission. I suggest splitting it into reading the old and the current format with a shared step for names and expenses and choosing the reader by one table "version — reader"; check the support of a version by the keys of this table.

Second, small: inside the argument of the error there is a nested condition; it will go away together with the first fix.

Third, for information: the message now says "minimal units", while the check and the documentation are still about kopecks; the renaming is planned for the following phases.

events.line: Understood, fixing: I will split the reading of versions
events.text:
The verdict on phase 1: SENT BACK FOR REWORK. Fix it, do not commit, run the formatting and the checks, then report.

First: the function that reads a bill by version uses a derived flag that changes the behavior in three places (the tuple length, the error text, reading the currency). This breaks the rules "a flag does not switch behavior" and exhaustive branching. Any version other than the first silently goes the way of the second, and the supported versions are also listed separately. Split it into reading the old and the current format with a shared step for names and expenses; choose the reader by one table "version — reader" and check the support by its keys.

Second: the nested condition in the error argument will go away with the first — the error text belongs to the version reader.

Third, only for information: the name of the check about kopecks and the message about minimal units will diverge — this is solved in phase 2.

events.line: Here you are. Both remarks are closed, the checks are green
events.text:
Both remarks are fixed, the changes are only in the link code. The formatting and the checks passed, nothing is committed.

First: the former function with the flag is deleted. Now there are two readers — for version 1 and version 2 — and the shared step for names and expenses is extracted separately. One table "version — reader" links the current and the old version to their readers; the version detection looks it up in the table and returns "unsupported version" if it did not find it. The separate support check is deleted, so the table is the only place with the list of versions.

Second: there is no nested condition in the error argument any more, each reader has its own text for a wrong length.

The behavior and the kinds of errors did not change, the phase 1 tests pass without changes. I did not touch the name of the check about kopecks, as agreed.

events.line: Accepted, I will recheck the rework of the first phase
events.text: The executor fixed your remarks on phase 1 in the link code: the function with a flag is replaced by two readers with a shared step for names and expenses, the supported versions are gathered in one table "version — reader", the version detection takes the reader from there, there is no nested condition in the error. Recheck the whole uncommitted set of changes the same way, run the checks and give the verdict "ACCEPTED" or "SENT BACK FOR REWORK" with remarks.

events.line: Accepted. The remarks are closed, phase 1 is ready
events.text:
ACCEPTED

I rechecked the whole uncommitted set: five changed files and the new currency file with its test. The checks pass, 342 tests, no errors or warnings.

All three remarks of the first pass are fixed. The former function with a flag is gone: the readers of the old and the current format are separated and share a common step, each handles exactly one format. The only list of supported versions is the table "version — reader", adding a version means adding a reader and an entry. There is no nested condition in the error any more.

The criteria of phase 1 are still met: old links open without a currency, new codes start with "2.", the encoding round trip keeps the bill and the currency, invalid forms of versions 1 and 2 give an invalid bill, versions 0, 3 and 99 are unsupported, the calculation is not touched.

There are no new remarks. For the future: the message says "minimal units", while the check and the documentation are still about kopecks; the plan will rename this in phases 2 and 6.

events.line: Accepted, I do the second phase: dictionaries and formatting
events.text:
Implement only phase 2 of the statement for task #10 — moving the interface texts into the English and Russian dictionaries. Phase 1 is already committed: the app uses the currency constant "rubles".

The tests of the phase are needed: formatting and dictionaries, the renaming of the amount parsing, the explanation of the calculation in Russian with rubles and in English with dollars. In the app tests add the ability to mount the app with a language (do not change any Russian tests), a group "English page" (the header texts, the overview "0 participants · 0 expenses · spent $0.00", a scenario with amounts in dollars) and an old version 1 link on the English page in dollars. Remove the currency constant: the currency becomes the state of the app — from the link or the default for the language, as in the plan. The page is still one with the Russian language: two pages are phase 3, the currency choice is phase 4. If it is local to the link, rename the kopecks check to "minimal units", do not touch the calculation.

Do not commit. The Russian texts are verbatim. Leave no interface strings outside the dictionaries in the components. Follow the readability rules: named intermediate results, no flags that switch behavior, nesting no deeper than two. Run the formatting, keep the checks green.

In the report: the changed files, what was done, deviations from the plan with reasons and the result of the checks.

events.line: Here you are. Phase 2 is ready, 415 tests and the build are green
events.text:
Phase 2 is implemented and not committed. The formatting is applied, the checks are green: formatting, types, linter, 415 tests in 13 files, the build. The calculation is not touched.

New: the descriptions of the languages (English and Russian, the language tag, the name, the default currency), the dictionary interface with nested groups and functions for texts with substitution, the Russian dictionary verbatim, the new English dictionary, the formatting of numbers, amounts and plural forms, the language context for components, the helper for formatting amounts.

Changed: the amount parsing is renamed, the formatting of rubles is deleted; in the link code the kopecks check is renamed to "minimal units"; the app gets the language, the currency is the state (from the link or the default for the language), the language is read once with an explanation; all components take the texts from the dictionary, the amounts from the formatter; the functions of the calculation explanation get the dictionary and the formatter; the page is still one with the Russian language; the dictionaries folder is added to the DOM ban; the former plural module is deleted.

Tests: formatting (Russian and English forms, thousands separators, amounts in all four combinations, zero and a very large amount), dictionaries (all plural forms and currency names), the renamed amount parsing, the calculation explanation in both languages, in the app tests — mounting with a language, the group "English page" and the Russian page with a dollar link.

Deviations: the texts are grouped into nested objects instead of flat keys; the recipient list is joined inside the dictionary, because the separator is part of the language; the transfer arrow and the plus and minus signs lie in the dictionaries; the expense form errors became typed with exhaustive branching; the length limits and the number of ordinary transfers go through formatting; the participants section gets the currency but does not use it; the currency names are not shown in the interface yet. Out of scope remained: the name of the type "kopecks", the Russian locale in the avatar and the amount input without regard to the language.

events.line: Accepted, I will check the second phase against the criteria
events.text:
Review the uncommitted changes by the project rules and the task: phase 2 of task #10 (moving the texts into the English and Russian dictionaries) and its tests. Do not demand later phases, phase 1 is committed.

Criteria: dictionaries with the same keys, a missing one is a type error, the plural form categories are fixed by a test; plurals through Intl.PluralRules, numbers through Intl.NumberFormat; amounts in four combinations ($1,250.50, 1 250,50 $, ₽1,250.50, 1 250,50 ₽); there are no interface strings in the components outside the dictionaries; the Russian texts are verbatim, the Russian app tests were not changed; the app renders in English; the currency is the state of the app; the calculation is not touched, in the bill folder there is only the renaming in the money file; the dictionaries folder is without the DOM.

The executor named deviations: nested groups of texts, joining the recipients in the dictionary, the arrow and signs in the dictionaries, typed form errors, formatting numbers for the limits, an unused currency in the participants section, the helper for formatting amounts, reading the language once, an optional section title in the helper functions of the tests.

Run the checks. Give the verdict "ACCEPTED" or "SENT BACK FOR REWORK" with concrete remarks; raise only real defects and rule violations, not matters of taste.

events.line: Returning it: the currency logic has no tests
events.text:
SENT BACK FOR REWORK

The checks pass: formatting, the type check without errors, the linter, 415 tests of 415, the build. Almost all criteria of phase 2 are met: the dictionaries are typed, the plural form categories are fixed by a test, the four amount formats are checked, no Russian interface strings are left in the components, the Russian texts match verbatim, the old app tests were not changed, the calculation is not touched, the dictionaries folder is without the DOM. The executor's deviations are justified.

Serious. The new logic of the currency signal in the app has no tests, while the rule requires a test next to it. Not checked: an edit of a bill opened in another currency must keep its currency in the address (if it is replaced by the default currency, no test fails, and a dollar bill on the Russian page silently becomes a ruble one); rolling the currency back to the page currency on a broken link or an empty fragment; that the "Share" link after opening a dollar link carries dollars. Two or three tests are needed on the Russian page with a dollar link and a transition to a broken or an empty fragment.

Small. Renaming the kopecks check in the link code goes beyond the plan and is not named in the report. An identical minus sign constant with an identical comment lies in two dictionaries, breaking "one source of truth". In the app tests the code of the old link is repeated verbatim, and the literal of the dollar link is inserted once more outside its group. The announcement reading helper duplicates the existing ones and silently swallows the absence of the element. The functions of the calculation explanation get the language in different ways, and the name of the parameter is inaccurate. The comment in the linter settings is outdated.

There are no secrets, server addresses or personal data.

events.line: Understood, fixing: currency tests, the minus, the literals
events.text:
The verdict on phase 2: SENT BACK FOR REWORK. Fix it, do not commit, run the formatting and the checks, report.

1. Serious: the new logic of the currency signal has no tests. Add: on the Russian page open a dollar link, add a participant and check that the address still gives dollars; go to a broken and to an empty fragment and check that the amounts returned to the page currency; after opening a dollar link the "Share" link must carry dollars.

2. Leave the renaming of the kopecks check: the lead asked for it.

3. Move the identical minus sign in two dictionaries into a shared module and use it from both.

4. Raise the duplicates of the link literals in the app tests to the file level, reuse them, and put the test "old link on the English page in dollars" into the group of old links next to the version 1 test.

5. Merge the announcement reading helper with the existing ones, adding an optional section title, and let it fail loudly when the element is missing.

6. In the functions of the calculation explanation make the input data about the language uniform and remove the inaccurate name.

7. Update the outdated comment in the linter settings.

events.line: Here you are. All seven remarks are closed, 420 tests are green
events.text:
All seven remarks are fixed. I ran the formatting, the checks are green (420 tests in 13 files, the build), nothing is committed.

1. The tests of the currency logic: the group for the Russian page now checks that opening a dollar link and adding a participant keep dollars in the address, that a transition to a broken or an empty fragment returns rubles and the amount label with ₽ (the Russian "how much" label), and that the "Share" link after a dollar link gives dollars. I kept the test about dollar amounts and added a ruble link on the Russian page. I did not run a check that the tests fail when the rollback is broken.

2. The renaming of the kopecks check is left.

3. The minus sign is now in one shared module, both dictionaries import it; the test keeps its own literal of the expected value.

4. The link literals are moved to the file level with comments, the duplicate is deleted, the test of the old link on the English page is moved next to the version 1 test.

5. The announcement helper is deleted, the existing ones accept an optional section title and fail when the element is missing.

6. All functions of the calculation explanation take the language as the same last parameter, the inaccurate name is removed.

7. The comment in the linter settings is updated.

events.line: Accepted, I will recheck and run the mutations
events.text: The executor fixed the remarks on phase 2: new app tests on the Russian page (a dollar link with an edit, a transition to a broken and an empty fragment, "Share" after a dollar link); the kopecks check is left because the lead asked for the renaming; the minus sign in a shared module; the link literals at the file level; the announcement helpers merged; the functions of the calculation explanation take the language uniformly; the linter comment updated. Recheck the whole set of changes, run the checks and, since the executor did not do it, briefly check item 1 by mutations: temporarily substitute the default currency when writing the address and remove the currency rollback, make sure the tests fail, then restore it as it was and show that there are no traces. The verdict "ACCEPTED" or "SENT BACK FOR REWORK".

events.line: Accepted. The mutations are caught, phase 2 is ready
events.text:
ACCEPTED

All seven remarks are closed, the checks pass, and the mutation check of item 1 showed that the new tests catch all four breakages.

Checks on the current working copy: formatting, the type check without errors, the linter, 420 tests of 420, the build.

What is fixed. The currency logic is checked by tests: after an edit the address keeps dollars, a broken and an empty fragment return rubles, the "Share" link carries dollars. The renaming of the kopecks check was requested by the lead, I withdraw the remark. The minus sign lies in one place. The link codes are moved to the file level and are not duplicated. The announcement helpers accepted an optional title and fail when the element is missing. The functions of the calculation explanation take the language the same way. The linter comment is updated.

The mutation check. I did not touch the working copy: I made the mutations in a copy of the project, linking the dependencies, and each time restored the original file. The address with the default currency instead of the current one, the removed rollback on a broken link, the currency not reset on an empty fragment and passing the default currency to the "Share" section — each mutation made exactly one corresponding test fail. After the check the copy matched the working one.

A small thing, it does not affect the verdict: in the app tests there are two similar helpers for changing the address in different groups, they can be merged into one.

events.line: Accepted, I do the third phase: two pages and the language
events.text:
Implement only phase 3 of the statement for task #10 — English at the root, Russian on a separate page and the language switch. Phases 1 and 2 are committed.

Tests are needed in the group "Language switch" in the app tests: for an untouched bill in the page currency the link is without a fragment, in the other cases with an encoded fragment of version 2; following the link keeps the bill and the currency (for example, build a bill on the English page, take the fragment, mount on the Russian one and see the same bill in rubles); the link has lang and hreflang. The currency choice is phase 4, SEO is phase 5, do not add them. Keep the rest of the page header content and the look, the heading is taken from the dictionary.

At the same time remove a small thing from the last review: in the app tests there are two similar address change helpers, merge them into one at the file level that takes an address.

Styles only through tokens; the toolbar row must not give horizontal scroll at 360 px; the touch target of the language link is not less than 44 px, the focus is visible. Check the look of the header at 360 and 1280 px in both languages and in both themes with a Playwright script outside the repository without new dependencies, and check that the content width does not exceed the window.

Do not commit. Do not read the browser language and do not make redirects. Run the formatting, keep the checks green, make sure that in the built pages the English one has lang=en and the Russian one lang=ru.

In the report: the changed files, what was done, deviations, the result of the checks, the findings of the visual check.

events.line: Here you are. Phase 3 is ready, both pages build
events.text:
Phase 3 is implemented and not committed. After the last style fix the checks pass: formatting, types, linter, 430 tests, the build. The visual check found no problems.

What was done. The page path is added to the language description: empty for English and separate for Russian. One template page by the list of languages replaced the former one: it sets lang, the heading from the dictionary and the app with the language; the rest of the header content and the main block are unchanged. A function of the address of the page in the other language and a switch component are added: a link to each other language, with the name in its own language, lang and hreflang. The address gets a fragment with the encoded bill and currency, and only an empty bill in the page currency keeps the plain path. In the header a toolbar row appeared, in the styles only tokens: a flex row with wrapping, the link has the height of a touch target and a visible focus.

Tests. The two address change helpers are merged into one; the helpers for adding a participant and an expense are moved to the file level. A new group of nine tests checks the text, lang, hreflang and the address of the link on both pages, the absence of a fragment for an untouched bill and its appearance after edits, an empty bill in another currency, and following the link with keeping the bill and the currency in both directions.

Deviations. There is no navigation label, because a new dictionary key is not needed: the links are clear by the text and lang. The page title is for now from the header heading, in phase 5 the SEO title will replace it. The link has no hover style: the accent on the soft accent gives 4.48:1, less than 4.5.

Checks. In the built pages the English one has lang=en, the Russian one lang=ru; the language link in the server markup is a plain path. There is no reading of the browser language and no redirects. Visually checked 16 combinations (language, theme, width 360 and 1280, an empty page and a page with a bill in rubles): there is no horizontal scroll, the link is 44 px high, it stands at the top right, the focus is visible in both themes. I did not shoot the 768 width because the change concerns only the header.

events.line: Here you are. Phase 4 is ready, the currency choice in the header works

events.text:

Tests are needed: the page metadata, robots and the render of the template page through the Astro container (details in the plan; the analyst checked that the container together with the Solid render works in Vitest, and for the linter a declaration of .astro modules is needed). For canonical addresses and alternates use the page path and the route parameter function — one source of the position of the pages. Install the sitemap plugin as a dependency, configure it by the languages from the language description, set the site address in the build settings and keep the base path.

SEO texts: a title up to about 60 characters and a description up to about 160, meaningful, in each language; the page title is taken from them. The block "How it works" is a static component under the island inside the main block: a second-level heading and three short steps from the dictionary, styles with tokens in the spirit of a soft card. Make sure that the server markup of the island already contains h1 and the subtitle.

The preview images, English and Russian, exactly 1200×630: screenshots of the filled page in the light theme through Playwright outside the repository without new dependencies. For the English one take a new literal of a version 2 link with English names in dollars, for the Russian one — the literal of a version 1 link. Save the literal and the exact procedure in a note for the phase 6 documentation. Check the file sizes.

Also check the built files: the sitemap index and the sitemap with both addresses and the language alternates, robots, the tags in the head of both pages. Run Lighthouse once on each page as a quick check (build, preview server, mobile profile) and report the four scores; if below the thresholds (SEO 100, accessibility 100, best practices 95, performance 95), fix it within the phase. Do not commit the reports to the repository.

Do not commit. Run the formatting, keep the checks green. In the report: the files, what was done, deviations, the result of the checks, the Lighthouse scores, the image sizes.

events.line: Here you are. Phase 5 is ready, Lighthouse is 100 everywhere
events.text:
Phase 5 is implemented and not committed. The checks are green (formatting, types, linter, 485 tests, the build). Lighthouse (mobile profile, one run per page) gave 1.0 for performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO on both pages, so nothing had to be fixed.

What was done. In the build settings the site address is set, the base path is kept, the comment about the missing address is replaced by the reason (canonical, the sitemap, the preview), the sitemap plugin is configured by the languages from the language description. The sitemap dependency is installed and the types for jsdom as a development dependency. The metadata folder is added to the DOM ban. The page metadata function builds canonical, the alternates (English, Russian and x-default to English), the image address, the caption, the title and the description, the Open Graph locales and the JSON-LD WebApplication; the paths are taken from the page path, so it stays the only source. A test checks the exact addresses, x-default, the image addresses, the JSON-LD fields, the length limits of the title and the description and the absence of "<" in the serialized JSON-LD. A separate function builds the site root from the site address and the base path and fails with a clear error without an address; the page and robots use it. Robots is a text function and a thin endpoint pointing to the sitemap index. The head component assembles the encoding, the viewport, theme-color, the icon, the title, the description, canonical, three hreflang, all Open Graph and Twitter tags and JSON-LD. The component "How it works" is a section with a heading and an ordered list of three steps under the island. The template page uses all this. The dictionaries get the groups of SEO texts and "How it works", the block styles are tokens, it looks like the other cards. A declaration of .astro modules is added.

The SEO texts. The English title: "Split the Bill — Who Owes Whom, Fewest Transfers", the Russian one: "Split the bill — who owes whom how much" (in Russian). The descriptions fit into 160 characters, a test checks this.

The container test. In the jsdom environment the Solid server render fails, so the test runs in the ordinary Node environment and parses the HTML through JSDOM. It checks for both languages lang, the title, the description, canonical, the set of hreflang, the Open Graph and Twitter tags, the image size, the JSON-LD type, theme-color, h1, the subtitle, the heading and the steps of the block.

The build and the check without JavaScript. The output folder has both pages, robots, the sitemap index and the sitemap; the sitemap contains both addresses with the alternates en and ru; robots contains rules for everyone and a link to the index. With JavaScript turned off h1, the subtitle and the steps are visible. Shots at 360 and 1280 px in both themes without horizontal scroll.

The preview images. Both are 1200×630, 8-bit RGB, light theme, the window of the filled page; the sizes are about 66 KB. The English one uses the new literal of a version 2 link: four participants in dollars and three expenses of 480, 125.05 and 60 dollars; the Russian one — the version 1 literal. The literal and the procedure are saved in the note.

Lighthouse. Both pages: performance, accessibility, best practices and SEO are 1.0 each. The reports lie outside the repository.

Deviations. The page test is named with an underscore, otherwise Astro considers a file in the pages folder a route and the build fails. I added the jsdom types, otherwise the type check rejects the import. I added the site root function with a test so as not to duplicate logic. The image caption is taken from a new SEO texts key, the site name and the name in JSON-LD from the header heading. In the container the base path is "/", so the test expects addresses without the project path. The sitemap alternates do not contain x-default — this is a plugin limitation, the page heads have x-default.

The rest. My preview server is stopped; I did not touch the project rules and the README, that is phase 6.
